sections.content: How many people are "managers and directors in the creative industries"?

70,815 people

were counted on the census as "managers and directors in the creative industries" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Managers and directors in creative industries organise and co-ordinate the activities and resources of organisations in sectors such as arts, publishing, music, media, design and architecture.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 45 to 49 years. Of the whole working population 11% were aged 45 to 49 years. For people working as "managers and directors in the creative industries", 14.6% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "managers and directors in the creative industries" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "managers and directors in the creative industries" included:

  • higher education teaching professionals
  • travel agency managers and proprietors
  • chief executives and senior officials

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "managers and directors in the creative industries" there were more men than women (66.1% compared with 33.9%).

This means "managers and directors in the creative industries" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "other managers and proprietors".

Men made up 66.1% and women made up 33.9% of "managers and directors in the creative industries"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "managers and directors in the creative industries" included:

  • market and street traders and assistants
  • police officers (sergeant and below)
  • IT project managers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "managers and directors in the creative industries" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged 50 years and older, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "managers and directors in the creative industries" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "managers and directors in the creative industries", 7.7% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (76.5% compared with 23.5%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (60.3%) than self-employed (39.7%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Hackney, this is in the same region of London.
